messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: can we summarize the concrete reasons we won vs lost this quarter and list the top customer asks to close those gaps?
Owen Li: From customer intel: wins often tied to predictable latency + clear on-boarding (fast PoC). Losses clustered around lack of compliance artifacts, unclear cost forecasting for long-run usage, and missing guarantees for model stability.
Samir Patel: Sales snapshot: Win triggers = 1) reliable SLA during demo, 2) demo-to-prod playbook, 3) clear pricing examples. Loss triggers = 1) SOC2/data residency questions, 2) pricing surprises at scale, 3) customers wanting to pin model versions.
Leah O'Neill: CS adds: procurement/infosec teams want a one-pager "security summary" they can hand to reviewers plus an install checklist for Private. When we provide that, conversion improves significantly.
Nora Kim: Product notes: the two product asks we keep seeing are (A) model pinning or deterministic rollout controls and (B) cost controls (token caps, cheaper long-context variants). Both affect roadmap prioritization.
Rajiv Menon: Ops/eng perspective: quick wins we can commit to: publish a security summary template (10 business days), ship a model-pinning beta API (4 weeks), and introduce a long-context cost profile doc (2 weeks). Need confirmations on owners.
Maya Chen: Please add single-line acceptance criteria with owners so I can escalate. Example: security summary = Heather V + Leah O'Neill -> template + 2 customer validations; model-pinning beta = Nora Kim -> API + 2 beta customers; cost-profile doc = Owen Li -> published docs + example calc.
Samir Patel: I'll prioritize accounts paused for compliance and route them to Heather's team. Also running a quick pricing experiment for mid-market commits.
Leah O'Neill: I'll coordinate the two customer validations for the security summary and post results here.
Nora Kim: Confirmed owner for model-pinning beta + I'll draft a short RFC with API surface and rollback hooks. ETA ~30 days.
notes-bot: All-hands clip + notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/records/allhands-2026-03-22-debrief ; action tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/allhands-1975554321
Maya Chen: Great. Can we reconvene with owner one-liners and any early numbers in 10 business days? I'll pull into the planning board. :thumbsup:
